description: Makes a key for CodeGene's public REST API, for the person's own scripts and integrations. It can do only what its scopes allow (projects:read (see the workspace's projects), tasks:read (see the workspace's tasks and where each one stands), reports:read (see the workspace's reports)), as the person who made it, in this workspace only; give it the fewest scopes the job needs. The answer has the key, the API's address and a curl example. It is shown once and CodeGene keeps only a fingerprint of it, so give it to the person straight away and never write it anywhere else. It lasts 30 days unless days says otherwise (1 to 365). revoke_api_key ends it, and so does the person leaving the workspace. Only owners and admins.

days.description: How many days the key lasts (1 to 365; 30 if left out).

name.description: What the key is for, such as Nightly export: how the person finds it in the list later.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

scopes.description: What the key may do: one or more scopes.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: create_api_key
title: Make an API key
